_doc: Hitbox spec for the v3 slash trail designs. All lengths in field (logical) px of the 384x216 screen; x3 display = 1 px -> 3 screen px. Origin = hero feet (hero.x, hero.y); +x = facing direction (east; mirror x for west), +y = screen down. Active ticks are 60fps game ticks from attack start. The trail body is clipped to the hitbox: filled fan/band = hit area; bright rim = outer reach. Live hit area at tick t (active) = part of the shape with sweep fraction <= head(t), head(t) = 1-(1-clamp((t-a0+1)/sweep_ticks))^2.

screen.scale: integer k = floor(min(CW/384, CH/216)) (world.js L1006); x3 = 1152x648
